facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 8/17 of 12 September 2017, binding on operators of clearing and settlement subsystems, payment service providers and participants, entered into force on publication and replaced Aviso 11/15.

The Aviso rests on Lei n.º 5/05 of 29 July 2005, the Payment System Law of Angola, which it cites as the basis for BNA regulation and for the sanctions regime; the document gives no sign the law was repealed.

systems.system: SPTR - Subsistema de Pagamentos em Tempo Real
SIGMA - Subsistema de Gestao de Mercados e Activos
CCAA - Camara de Compensacao Automatizada de Angola
STC - Subsistema de Transferencias a Credito
SCC - Subsistema de Compensacao de Cheques
SPMA - Subsistema Pagamentos Moveis de Angola

note: No fact on non-bank licensing or mandatory connection: the Aviso names payment service providers as subject to it but states neither that non-banks are licensed nor any rule that providers connect.
